operationalMeasure: Similarity between source and target legal tradition plus experience with constitutional or abstract review
sourceFamilies: JuriGlobe; V-Dem v2jureview; Comparative Constitutions Project; CODICES
notes: Use as adaptation-cost prior rather than as a deterministic legal-family claim.

operationalMeasure: Years since adoption of constitutional review or specialized constitutional-court practice
sourceFamilies: Comparative Constitutions Project; CODICES; national constitutional histories
notes: May also adjust political-culture sensitivity and implementation lag.

operationalMeasure: Effective number of parliamentary parties or comparable legislative fragmentation
sourceFamilies: PPEG; DPI; ParlGov; national election datasets
recommendedRawRange: under 2 concentrated; 2-4 moderate; 4-6 fragmented; over 6 highly fragmented
notes: Higher fragmentation can either increase pluralism or reduce response capacity; keep direction mechanism-specific.

operationalMeasure: Government seat share divided by constitutional amendment or override threshold
sourceFamilies: PPEG; DPI; ParlGov; national parliamentary records
recommendedRawRange: under 0.80 blocked; 0.80-1.00 near threshold; 1.00-1.10 narrow control; over 1.10 dominant
notes: Separate control that enables compliance from control that enables capture or retaliation.

operationalMeasure: Months until next scheduled national election or expected election window
sourceFamilies: ParlGov; national electoral calendars; election authority records
recommendedRawRange: over 24 low; 12-24 moderate; 6-12 high; under 6 acute
notes: Use to modulate response credibility and short-run court-curbing incentives.

sourceFamilies: V-Dem v2cacamps; reversed V-Dem v2smpolsoc; CHES; manifesto-based measures
notes: High endogeneity risk; use in sensitivity sweeps before treating as calibration.

sourceFamilies: V-Dem v2x_cspart; V-Dem v2csprtcpt; V-Dem v2cseeorgs; CIVICUS; CSOSI
notes: Feeds litigant capacity and public-interest support rather than merely legitimacy.

operationalMeasure: Survey share expressing trust or confidence in courts or justice system
sourceFamilies: WVS; OECD Trust Survey; Eurobarometer; EU Justice Scoreboard
notes: Survey comparability is weak; keep context-specific and do not validate case outcomes with trust rows.

operationalMeasure: High-court independence and observed judicial compliance
sourceFamilies: V-Dem v2juhcind; V-Dem v2juhccomp; V-Dem v2exrescon; World Justice Project
notes: Useful for compliance conditions but causally entangled with regime quality.

operationalMeasure: Disposition time or clearance rate for relevant courts
sourceFamilies: CEPEJ; EU Justice Scoreboard; national court annual reports
recommendedRawRange: under 200 days strong; 200-400 mixed; over 400 weak
notes: Convert to simulator delay/capacity scale before use.

operationalMeasure: Government effectiveness and rights-respecting implementation environment
sourceFamilies: World Bank WGI Government Effectiveness; V-Dem v2clrspct; comparative constitutional compliance datasets
recommendedRawRange: WGI under -0.5 weak; -0.5 to 0.5 moderate; over 0.5 strong
notes: Keep separate from formal institutional design and court independence.

operationalMeasure: Weighted combination of compatibility capacity trust civil society and inverse partisan pressure
recommendedRawRange: weights: legal tradition 0.20; court independence/compliance 0.20; implementation capacity 0.20; civil society 0.15; trust 0.15; partisan-pressure penalty 0.10
notes: Use as a transparent sensitivity construct until each component has a verified source series.
